caption:
spicy short rib brothy rice bowl 🌶️ 🍚 

SOUPS THAT DON’T SUCK / episode 61

the ultimate comfort food! I don’t think i’ve stopped thinking about this bowl since I made.

a couple years ago, I got to work with a Thai chef Jam Sanitchat who taught me her yellow curry, and I’ve been so in love with it and making it at home ever since. this is my take on a Thai curry broth, using red curry paste, poured hot over rice with these fall apart tender short ribs.

the best part is the pressure cooker because it definitely saves you time (although I have instructions for alternate methods on my blog if you want!)

it’s cozy, it’s comforting, warming and exactly what I want in a bowl right now 💕

you can comment ‘SOUP’ and I’ll send it to you directly or click the link in my bio for the full recipe xx

#soupsthatdontsuck #spicysoup #comfortfood #souprecipe #soupseason
author: britacooks
transcript: Welcome to Soups That Don't Suck, episode 61. We're making a spicy short rib brothy rice bowl. The broth is a silky, coconut curry base with the perfect amount of spice and the short ribs just melt in your mouth. This is definitely my dream comfort food kind of meal. Start by seasoning the short ribs with salt and then searing on all sides. I'm doing this in a pressure cooker to save some time. The red curry paste is next, fry that a little then shallots, ginger and garlic. Next, we're gonna add the ribs back in, along with a touch of soy sauce and beef stock, fish sauce and then finally some brown sugar. Pressure cook this on high for 45 minutes then let it release naturally. We're gonna shred the meat from the short ribs and then, okay, back to our broth. So strain out the aromatics, finish with coconut milk so it's nice and creamy. The broth goes over the rice and beef and then we're gonna garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. That's it. Hope you like it.
title: Spicy Short Rib Brothy Rice Bowl
one_liner: Pressure-cooked short ribs in a coconut red curry broth served over rice for ultimate comfort food.
key_points: Sear short ribs, fry red curry paste, then add shallots, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, fish sauce, beef stock, and brown sugar
Pressure cook on high for 45 minutes with a natural release, then shred the meat
Strain aromatics from the broth and finish with coconut milk for a silky, creamy base
Pour hot broth over rice and beef, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds

instructions: 1. Season short ribs with salt and sear on all sides in the pressure cooker.
2. Fry red curry paste in the pot, then add shallots, ginger, and garlic.
3. Add ribs back in with soy sauce, beef stock, fish sauce, and brown sugar.
4. Pressure cook on high for 45 minutes, then let pressure release naturally.
5. Shred meat from the short ribs.
6. Strain aromatics from the broth and stir in coconut milk.
7. Serve hot broth over rice and shredded beef; garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
